text:
lee: FYI we started seeing a burst of KMS 429s from edge-keystore around 01:10 UTC. Affected: some us-west-2 and eu-west-1 GPU node joins and audit shipping. NAT gateway NAT-EDGE-03 QPS spiked.

anika: Any recent firewall or IAM changes?

lee: We rolled a stricter SG for keystore earlier as part of the compliance cutover (default-deny). Looks like the audit shipper VPCE couldn't assume the privatelink principal and fell back to NAT. Logs: `KMS.DecryptResourceThrottling: Rate exceeded` and `keystore-proxy: decrypt retry exhausted`.

raf: If privatelink fallback didn't happen it's likely the endpoint policy lacked the shipper role ARN. We should avoid reverting default-deny if we can add a narrow SG exception + endpoint policy.

ops-bot: rollout: security-group edge-keystore updated (rollout_id=po-2026-03-xx-01)

mika: Short term we can: 1) add VPCE principal allow for arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/audit-shipper on vpce-ks-edge 2) create SG rule allowing VPCE CIDR and shipper ENI 3) reduce audit sampling from 100% -> 30% during the window 4) throttle keystore client retries.

ryan: I'll open a quick PR to add the SG exception (https://git.internal/r/infra/sg-exceptions/pulls/210). Want minimal surface: allow only vpce-ks-edge and eni-eni-0abc for now.

anika: Also please add an automated verification in the policy rollout: check that VPCE principal mapping exists and that VPCE returns 200 on AssumeRole / GetCallerIdentity.

lee: mika, can you flip sampling to 30% and increase backoff jitter? That should immediately reduce KMS grant QPS.

mika: Done. Sampling toggled at 01:22 UTC, client backoff changed to initial 5s -> max 75s with jitter.

raf: Observability: NAT QPS down by ~70% after SG exception; KMS 429s dropped to baseline within 20m. Node joins resumed and warm pool recovered (4/4 replaced).

ryan: Sec approved the targeted SG exception (rule ex-175100). We'll follow up with endpoint policy PR to lock down VPCE principal mapping.

anika: Compliance: open a short-lived exception ticket and document the sampling change + TTL. We need the endpoint policy PR merged within 48h or revert sampling.

lee: Cost estimate: the fallback to NAT for ~9h looks like ~USD 1.6k additional egress. Add to monthly variance.

mika: Action items: ryan -> merge SG exception PR and annotate; anika -> endpoint policy PR + automation test; raf -> add a postrollout test to the firewall playbook that validates privatelink behaviour; lee -> cost variance note.

lee: Thanks team, leave this channel if you see any new KMS throttles overnight. :thumbsup:
